messages.subject: Re: Graph with 3 axes
parts:
ggplot2 can't do 3 dimensions in the same plot. 

I've used rgl to do that before. 

library(rgl)

plot3d(data$Value, data$Chroma, data$Hue, pch=30, col=data$HexValue, size=30)
